title: LoopKeeperMeetingExtraction
description: Structured action items extracted from a single meeting's raw notes/transcript.

meeting_date.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the meeting. Provided by the caller, echoed back for validation.

meeting_title.description: Short title/subject of the meeting if stated, else null.

attendees.description: Names mentioned as present, if identifiable. Best-effort; empty array if unknown.

action_items.description: One entry per distinct action item mentioned in this meeting. Include an item even if it looks like a duplicate/follow-up of a task from a previous meeting — deduplication is handled downstream by the state engine, NOT by the extractor.

raw_text.description: The verbatim sentence(s) from the notes this item was extracted from.

action_description.description: A clean, third-person, verb-first restatement of the task, e.g. 'Draft the Q4 pitch deck'. Strip filler words but preserve the specific subject matter — this text feeds a semantic similarity matcher, so precision here matters more than brevity.

assignee.description: The person responsible, exactly as named/referred to in the notes (e.g. 'Bhaveesha', 'she', resolved to the nearest named antecedent). Never invent a name — if no owner is stated or inferable, use 'Unassigned'.

deadline.description: Resolved ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Relative phrases ('by Friday', 'next week', 'end of month') MUST be resolved against meeting_date. Null if no deadline was stated.

deadline_phrase_raw.description: The original deadline phrase as spoken, e.g. 'by end of next week', for audit purposes.

status_explicit.description: Status ONLY if explicitly stated or unambiguously implied in this meeting (e.g. 'I finished the deck' -> done; 'still waiting on legal' -> blocked). Use 'none' if the meeting only mentions/restates the task without commenting on its status — the state engine will infer status from deadlines and prior state in that case.

is_followup_reference.description: True if the speaker explicitly references this as a previously-discussed/ongoing item (e.g. 'following up on the pitch deck', 'same as last week'). False if it reads as a brand-new ask. This is a hint for the dedup engine, not a guarantee — final matching is decided by semantic similarity + assignee matching.

pushback_signal.description: True if the notes explicitly describe the deadline moving later (e.g. 'pushing this to next Friday', 'need more time'). Helps the state engine distinguish a genuine pushback from a first-time deadline.

notes.description: Any additional context useful for the audit trail (blockers, reasons for delay, etc.).

confidence.description: Extractor's self-assessed confidence that this is a genuine, actionable item (not small talk or a completed FYI).
